content: {"rules": ["The model exhibits a persistent upward bias, consistently overestimating prices by 2-5 EUR across all horizons.", "Forecasts fail to capture immediate mean reversion following price spikes; the model assumes a smooth continuation of the trend rather than a sharp correction.", "There is a significant lag in reacting to downward volatility; the model continues to project increases for 5-10 days after the true price has already peaked and begun falling.", "Sentiment signals (values > 0) do not trigger sufficient downward adjustments in the forecast, indicating the model underweights negative sentiment or fails to interpret it as a reversal signal.", "The model systematically overshoots the peak and undershoots the trough, resulting in a 'flattened' forecast curve that misses the true volatility range of the market."]}
